text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hybrid + travel ops (desk booking, offsites, reimbursements). Drop short Qs and we'll reply in-thread.
Sam: Are team offsite stipends still $500/person?
Nina (People Ops): Yes for teams <50. Use Concur, tag `OPS_OFFSITE`, attach attendee list.
Ivy: If I travel to meet a customer, can I expense coworking day passes?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, up to $50/day under `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`. Personal coworking days not covered.
Diego: Desk portal shows full. Any overflow plan for the week after all-hands?
Nina (People Ops): Join the waitlist; we'll open overflow in Commons and convertible meeting rooms. For customer visits, mark reason in the desk note and we'll prioritize.
Rina: Do we cover PCR/required travel tests for company-directed international trips?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, code as `HEALTH_TRAVEL`. Voluntary travel = personal.
Sam: How fast are reimbursements?
Nina (People Ops): Typically 7-10 business days post manager approval. DM if delayed.
Ivy: Can managers approve last-minute travel?
Nina (People Ops): Up to $1k/person. Above that ops approval required.
Diego: Shipping company laptop to a hub  reimbursable?
Nina (People Ops): Yes. Use `EQUIPMENT_SHIP` and add tracking. Cross-border shipments may need customs paperwork.
Rina: Parking/Electric vehicle charging reimbursable for hub visits?
Nina (People Ops): Yes  use `LOCAL_PARKING` and attach receipt. Daily commute parking not covered.
ops-bot: calendar: Created event "All-Hands Ops: Travel & Desk Followups" and attached Nina's notes.
Nina (People Ops): I'll post a one-pager with common Concur codes (`OPS_OFFSITE`, `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`, `HEALTH_TRAVEL`, `EQUIPMENT_SHIP`, `LOCAL_PARK`, `TRAVEL_CHILDCARE`) plus a 3-min Loom by EOD. DM for exceptions.
Sam: Thanks!! :thumbsup:
Ivy: Appreciate it.
